profile.story:
Farmer in Story County, Iowa reports hail destroyed about 60% of 120 acres of corn. Has crop insurance.
AI: Hi, this is Willow. How can I help? User: Hail came through last week and tore up most of my corn. About 120 acres out of 300, maybe 60 percent gone. I'm in Story County, Iowa. I do have crop insurance.
